Business Situation (1-2 lines): A faulty smoke detector in the backroom triggered a full evacuation. Shop floor unattended for 12 minutes.
Primary Decision: How do you respond in the moment?
Options (A-D): A) Stick to standard evacuation process  B) Adapt the response locally  C) Escalate to facilities and head office now  D) Reallocate team to secure the floor on re-entry
What Good Looks Like (Outcome): Safety risk closed cleanly, faulty detector replaced, team confidence in the protocol grows
What Goes Wrong (If Poor Choice): Safety risk lingers, second false alarm in the shift, loss of trust in the system
